items.original: Added GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra to model catalogs, with Sol as the default catalog selection. (#62106)

title.zh-TW: TUI 工作區預設開啟並排顯示預覽
title.en: TUI Workspace Enabled by Default with Side-by-Side Previews

body.zh-TW:
一邊請 AI 改資料、一邊還得另外開視窗翻文件，視線常在好幾個地方跳來跳去。現在 TUI（終端機裡的文字操作介面）的工作區會預設開啟，不用另外切換就能直接看到並排畫面。

主對話旁邊會直接列出可搜尋的文件預覽與圖片預覽。如果有子代理（幫主對話分頭處理工作的助手）在執行，它的完整對話紀錄也會一併擺在旁邊方便對照。⟦就像整理報告時把資料夾攤在書桌兩側，以前要逐份翻找核對，現在主稿旁直接擺好參考文件、圖片和分頭調查的筆記。⟧
body.en:
Having to open a separate window to flip through documents while asking AI to edit data often leaves your eyes jumping between several places. Now the TUI (a text-based interface in the terminal) workspace is enabled by default, so you can see a side-by-side layout without switching views.

Searchable document previews and image previews appear right next to the main conversation. If a subagent (an assistant that handles parallel work for the main conversation) is running, its full transcript is placed alongside it for easy comparison. ⟦Think of spreading folders across both sides of your desk while organizing a report: instead of flipping through files one by one, your reference docs, images, and side-investigation notes sit right next to your main draft.⟧

items.original: Enabled the TUI workspace by default, with searchable document previews, image previews, and subagent transcripts alongside the main conversation. (#61352, #61888, #61889, #61919, #62157)

title.zh-TW: 非 Vim 輸入區新增可自訂復原與重做鍵
title.en: Non-Vim Composer Adds Configurable Undo and Redo Shortcuts

body.zh-TW:
整理報告貼了一大段參考資料又附了檔案，卻手滑把整塊指令全刪掉。現在只要不是在 Vim（一種純鍵盤操作的編輯模式）下，提示詞輸入區都能設定復原與重做快捷鍵。

操作時不只純文字會恢復，先前夾帶的附件和大段貼上的內容也會完整回到輸入框裡。⟦跟在剪貼簿做拼貼一樣，不小心把剪好的圖文整塊掃掉，拉回一步就能把整張照片和長剪報原封不動放回桌面。⟧
body.en:
You paste a large block of reference material and attach a file while organizing a report, only to slip and delete the entire prompt. Now, as long as you are not in Vim (a keyboard-only editing mode), you can configure undo and redo shortcuts in the prompt composer.

When you trigger them, not only is plain text restored, but previously attached files and large pasted blocks also return intact to the input box. ⟦Just like making a collage on a clipboard, if you accidentally sweep away a whole chunk of cut-out text and images, stepping back puts the entire photo and long clipping right back on the table.⟧

items.original: Added configurable undo and redo shortcuts to the non-Vim prompt composer, including restoration of attachments and large pastes. (#61954)

title.zh-TW: codex exec 新增 --remote 參數
title.en: codex exec Adds --remote Flag

body.zh-TW:
遠端機器上已經跑著一個 Codex 服務，想在腳本裡直接交辦任務。只要執行下面這行指令，就能連上既有的應用程式伺服器，啟動或接續非互動式工作階段（送出指令後直接跑完、不需來回對話）：

```bash
codex exec --remote <ADDR> # 將 <ADDR> 換成目標伺服器位址
```

⟦如同工廠裡早就開機運轉的產線，直接把物料送上既有產線就能開工或續跑。⟧
body.en:
A Codex service is already running on a remote machine, and you want to dispatch tasks to it from a script. By running the command below, you can connect to an existing app server and start or resume noninteractive sessions (runs that finish after you send a command, without back-and-forth):

```bash
codex exec --remote <ADDR> # Replace <ADDR> with the target server address
```

⟦A factory production line is already up and running—you simply feed materials onto the existing line to start or continue work.⟧

items.original: Added `codex exec --remote <ADDR>` to start or resume noninteractive sessions on an existing app server. (#61707)

title.zh-TW: 終端機新增 /rc 與 /remote 管理遠端控制
title.en: Terminal Adds /rc and /remote to Manage Remote Control

body.zh-TW: 人離開電腦桌，想改用另一台裝置遙控本機跑著的對話，該怎麼快速配對？在終端機介面輸入 `/rc` 或 `/remote`，就能管理本機的遠端控制功能，並直接顯示裝置配對碼。⟦像在客廳連接智慧電視一樣，直接在螢幕叫出配對碼。⟧
body.en: When you step away from your desk and want to use another device to remotely control a conversation running locally, how do you pair quickly? In the terminal interface, enter `/rc` or `/remote` to manage local remote control and display device pairing codes directly. ⟦It is like connecting a smart TV in the living room by bringing up the pairing code right on the screen.⟧

items.original: Added `/rc` and `/remote` to manage local remote control and display device pairing codes from the TUI. (#62121)

title.zh-TW: /statusline 可自訂與選用 MCP 狀態列
title.en: /statusline Supports Custom and Selectable MCP Status Lines

body.zh-TW:
盯著終端機底部看久了，難免想把常用的外部工具資訊也釘在那一排。只要啟用 `tui_extensions_statusline`，就能用 `/statusline` 管理底部的資訊欄。

透過這個指令，你可以自由挑選現成樣式，或自己編寫要顯示的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）狀態列。⟦拿汽車儀表板來比方，以前出廠給哪幾顆燈號就只能看哪幾顆，現在能自己挑選或組裝想看的小工具欄位擺上去。⟧
body.en:
After staring at the bottom of the terminal for a while, it is natural to want information from your frequently used external tools pinned right there. Once `tui_extensions_statusline` is enabled, you can use `/statusline` to manage the bottom status bar.

Through this command, you can pick from ready-made styles or author your own MCP (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) status line to display. ⟦Compare it to a car dashboard: before, you could only watch the factory indicator lights, whereas now you can pick or assemble the widget fields you want to display.⟧

items.original: Added custom MCP status line selection and authoring through `/statusline` when `tui_extensions_statusline` is enabled. (#61979, #61988, #62037)

title.zh-TW: 切換或插話調整時不再覆蓋既有進度與權限
title.en: Switching or Steering No Longer Overwrites Progress and Permissions

body.zh-TW:
在多個任務之間切換、或在對話途中調整方向，原本的設定與寫到一半的內容現在都能穩穩留住。

切換或接續工作階段時，打到一半的草稿、排隊等送出的後續訊息，以及被打斷的輸入都會跟著原本的對話串留存。

把工作目錄換到別的資料夾時，原本設定好的權限設定檔會原封不動保留下來。

上一輪如果延遲送出完成通知，不會再誤把新一輪正在等待確認的權限核准直接取消。

在進行中的這一輪中途插話調整方向時，彙總的變更差異裡依然會保留更早之前的修改。

以前切個對話或改個目錄就得擔心草稿、權限與修改紀錄不見，現在這些進行中的狀態都能完整延續。
body.en:
Switching between tasks or adjusting direction mid-conversation now keeps your existing settings and half-written work intact.

When switching or resuming sessions, in-progress drafts, queued follow-up messages, and interrupted input stay with their original threads.

When changing your working directory to another folder, previously configured permission profiles remain untouched.

A late completion notification from a previous turn will no longer mistakenly cancel a pending permission approval for a newer turn.

When steering an active turn mid-way, aggregate diffs still preserve earlier edits.

Previously, switching conversations or changing directories meant worrying about losing drafts, permissions, and edit history; now these active states carry over intact.

items.original:
Preserved drafts, queued follow-ups, and interrupted input with their original threads when switching or resuming sessions. (#61216)
Kept permission profiles intact when changing working directories. (#61195)
Prevented late completion events from cancelling approvals for a newer turn. (#61801)
Preserved earlier edits in aggregate diffs when steering an active turn. (#61820)

title.zh-TW: 修正終端機捲動輸入與重繪異常
title.en: Fixed Terminal Scrolling Input and Redraw Issues

body.zh-TW: 在終端機裡滑動畫面查看內容，以前可能會碰到捲動時突然多出奇怪字元、輸入區游標亂跳，或沿用舊的終端機尺寸重繪畫面。這些問題已經修好，現在捲動、游標位置與終端機尺寸重繪都會正常運作。
body.en: When scrolling through content in the terminal, you might previously have run into stray characters appearing during scrolling, the composer caret jumping, or the screen redrawing with stale terminal dimensions. These issues are now fixed, so scrolling, caret placement, and terminal-dimension redraws all work properly.

items.original: Fixed scrolling that inserted stray characters, composer caret jumps, and redraws using stale terminal dimensions. (#62139, #62174, #62175)

title.zh-TW: 修正只發 ID token 的企業版 MCP 登入問題
title.en: Fixed Enterprise MCP Sign-In When Only ID Tokens Are Issued

body.zh-TW: 透過公司帳號驗證身分，有些服務只會核發 ID token（用來確認身分的授權令牌）。由於沒有附上用來續期的 refresh token，以前這種設定會讓企業版 MCP 登入失敗。這個問題已經修好，現在只拿到 ID token 也能正常登入企業版 MCP。
body.en: When verifying identity through a company account, some services only issue an ID token (an authorization credential used to verify identity). Because no refresh token was included for renewal, this setup previously caused enterprise MCP sign-in to fail. That issue is now fixed, so enterprise MCP sign-in works normally even when only an ID token is received.

items.original: Fixed enterprise MCP sign-in for identity providers that issue ID tokens without refresh tokens. (#62129)

title.zh-TW: 給自行編譯者：建置工具與 XML 套件更新
title.en: For Source Builders: Build Tooling and XML Package Updates

body.zh-TW:
這組底層調整主要針對從原始碼自行編譯、或負責打包發布的開發者。

原始碼建置流程與發布工具已經升級到 Rust 1.99.1。

處理 XML（一種常見的標籤式資料格式）的相依套件同步更新，並移除了已經過時的安全公告例外設定。
body.en:
This set of underlying updates is primarily for developers who build from source or handle packaging and releases.

Source build workflows and release tooling have been upgraded to Rust 1.99.1.

Dependencies for handling XML (a common tag-based data format) have been updated as well, and obsolete security advisory exceptions have been removed.

items.original:
Updated source builds and release tooling to Rust 1.99.1. (#61205)
Updated XML dependencies and removed obsolete security advisory exceptions. (#62068)

entries: Added Gemini 4 Neon (Low, Medium, High, and XHigh) to `/model` and `--model` when you sign in with Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`), and added support for Gemini 4 Neon through an enterprise model gateway.

Improved mouse selection in Markdown tables in the `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode and the artifact viewer: a drag that starts in a table now follows its columns, so you copy only the text of the column you drag in, or whole cells separated by tabs when you drag across columns, instead of the borders and the text of neighboring columns.

Improved how the agent works through multi-step tasks: it now runs independent searches, file reads, and edits together in one step and chains related shell commands into a single command, so tasks take fewer turns.

Fixed custom models in `settings.json` ignoring `modelFeatures` flags set to `false`, such as `supportsThinking` and `supportsToolCalls`, so the CLI no longer requests thinking or tool calls from a model you've marked as not supporting them.

Fixed agents starting a swarm on their own when you hadn't typed `/swarm`, which can use far more of your quota than a single agent; the swarm skill is no longer offered to the agent, and `/swarm` works as before.

Fixed `Ctrl` and `Alt` shortcuts, such as `Ctrl+C` and `Ctrl+D`, acting as a different key on non-QWERTY keyboard layouts like Neo2, Dvorak, AZERTY, or German QWERTZ in terminals such as Ghostty; shortcuts now follow your keyboard layout.
Fixed `Enter` adding a new line instead of running the command in `!` shell mode when Vim mode is on.
Fixed `agy update` on Android (Termux) failing with a `directory /apex/com.android.runtime/bin is not fully accessible` error.

Fixed the `/config` hint for the `Send Immediately` option of `Queued Messages`, which said it interrupts the agent; it now says your message joins the current turn and the agent reads it after its current step.

Fixed the `status` of `--output-format json` and `stream-json` results reading `ERROR`, with the error of a failed attempt, for runs that succeeded after the CLI retried a model request; they now report `SUCCESS`.
Fixed `agy acp` running the agent's shell commands in the directory the editor launched it from, such as your home directory, instead of the session's project folder.
Fixed `agy acp` ignoring the file contents an editor attaches to a prompt, such as a file with unsaved changes in Zed; the agent now sees the editor's copy instead of the last saved version on disk.

Fixed model pickers in editors connected through `agy acp`, such as Zed and JetBrains AI Chat, showing internal `MODEL_PLACEHOLDER_...` IDs and several rows with the same name when you use an enterprise model gateway; each model is now listed once under its model ID, and models that share a name show their ID next to it.

Fixed `agy acp` showing an `API error (attempt N)` message in the editor's chat each time the CLI retried a model request, even when the retry succeeded; retries are now silent, as in the terminal, and the chat shows an error only when every retry fails.

Fixed the built-in `/antigravity-guide` skill reading a redirect notice instead of the page when the agent looked up the Antigravity docs or changelog to answer your questions, such as what's new in the latest release.
Fixed the Remote Control browser view jumping when you answer a permission prompt; the conversation now stays where you were reading instead of sliding down as the prompt closes.

Fixed permission prompts in the Remote Control browser view resetting after a brief connection drop, which lost the option you had picked, your edits to the command or path, and anything you had typed for the `No` option.

title.zh-TW: 模型清單新增 Gemini 4 Neon
title.en: Gemini 4 Neon added to model list

body.zh-TW: 想改用新模型處理手邊的開發或資料整理工作，現在只要透過 `AGY_ADC_AUTH` 應用程式預設憑證登入，就能在指令裡選到它。在對話輸入 `/model`，或於啟動時帶上 `--model`，裡面多了 Gemini 4 Neon 的 `Low`、`Medium`、`High` 與 `XHigh` 四個選項。公司有架設企業模型閘道（集中控管連線的模型入口）的話，透過閘道也已支援 Gemini 4 Neon。⟦就像工具箱裡新添了一把四段力道的電鑽，不論用個人識別證或走公司統一入口，都能直接拿來上工。⟧
body.en: If you want to switch to a new model for your development or data-wrangling work, you can now select it in commands as long as you sign in with Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`). Enter `/model` in a conversation or pass `--model` at startup to see four new options for Gemini 4 Neon: `Low`, `Medium`, `High`, and `XHigh`. If your company runs an enterprise model gateway (a central entry point that controls model connections), Gemini 4 Neon is supported through it as well. ⟦Picture adding a four-speed power drill to your toolbox: whether you badge in with your own ID or walk through the company gate, you can pick it up and get right to work.⟧

items.original: Added Gemini 4 Neon (Low, Medium, High, and XHigh) to `/model` and `--model` when you sign in with Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`), and added support for Gemini 4 Neon through an enterprise model gateway.

title.zh-TW: Markdown 表格拖曳複製只取選定欄位
title.en: Markdown table drag-copy selects only chosen columns

body.zh-TW:
從 AI 生成的表格複製一欄文字，以前常把框線跟旁邊那欄的字一併帶進剪貼簿。這個改動套用在 `full screen (altscreen)` 顯示模式，以及用來瀏覽生成結果的產物檢視器。

只要滑鼠從 Markdown 表格內開始拖曳，選取範圍就會沿著欄位走。只在單一欄內拖曳，就只會複製那一欄的文字；跨欄拖曳時，則會複製完整儲存格並以 Tab 字元隔開，不再帶入框線或隔壁欄的字。⟦抄寫藥盒背面那張成分表時，以前手指一滑就會連格線和隔壁欄一起念錯行，現在視線會穩穩鎖在你要的那幾欄上。⟧
body.en:
Copying a column of text from an AI-generated table used to pull borders and words from the neighboring column into your clipboard. This change applies to the `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode and the artifact viewer used to browse generated results.

Whenever a mouse drag starts inside a Markdown table, the selection now follows its columns. Dragging within a single column copies only the text in that column; dragging across columns copies whole cells separated by tabs, without bringing in borders or text from adjacent columns. ⟦Think of reading an ingredients chart on the back of a medicine box: a slip of your finger used to drag your eyes across grid lines into the wrong column, whereas now your gaze stays locked onto the columns you want.⟧

items.original: Improved mouse selection in Markdown tables in the `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode and the artifact viewer: a drag that starts in a table now follows its columns, so you copy only the text of the column you drag in, or whole cells separated by tabs when you drag across columns, instead of the borders and the text of neighboring columns.

title.zh-TW: 代理合併執行多步驟任務以減少輪數
title.en: Agent batches multi-step tasks to take fewer turns

body.zh-TW: 交辦一個包含搜尋、讀寫檔案和下指令的任務，過去代理常拆成多輪分次處理。現在遇到這類多步驟任務，它會把彼此獨立的搜尋、讀檔與編輯集中到同一步驟一起執行，並將相關的終端機指令串成單一指令，因此能用更少的輪數完成任務。⟦跟進廚房備料一樣，以前洗一根蔥走一趟流理台、拿瓶醬油又走一趟，現在把互不衝突的備菜一次做好，相連的動作順手串起來，出餐就少繞好多彎。⟧
body.en: When given a task involving searches, file reads and writes, and shell commands, the agent used to split the work across multiple turns. Now, on multi-step tasks like these, it runs independent searches, file reads, and edits together in a single step and chains related shell commands into one command, completing the task in fewer turns. ⟦A cook prepping ingredients in a kitchen used to walk to the sink to wash one scallion and make another trip just for soy sauce; now all non-conflicting prep happens at once and connected steps are chained together, cutting out wasted trips before plating.⟧

items.original: Improved how the agent works through multi-step tasks: it now runs independent searches, file reads, and edits together in one step and chains related shell commands into a single command, so tasks take fewer turns.

title.zh-TW: 自訂模型不再忽略 settings.json 停用旗標
title.en: Custom models no longer ignore disabled flags in settings.json

body.zh-TW: 接上自己設定的模型卻老是收到思考或工具呼叫請求，以前就算把功能關掉也照送不誤。這個問題已經修好，現在只要在 `settings.json` 的 `modelFeatures` 把 `supportsThinking` 或 `supportsToolCalls` 設為 `false`，CLI 就不會再向不支援的模型要求這些功能。
body.en: Connecting a custom model used to still trigger thinking or tool-call requests even when those features were turned off. This issue is fixed: setting `supportsThinking` or `supportsToolCalls` to `false` under `modelFeatures` in `settings.json` now stops the CLI from requesting those features from models that do not support them.

items.original: Fixed custom models in `settings.json` ignoring `modelFeatures` flags set to `false`, such as `supportsThinking` and `supportsToolCalls`, so the CLI no longer requests thinking or tool calls from a model you've marked as not supporting them.

title.zh-TW: 代理不再擅自開啟 swarm 消耗額度
title.en: Agents no longer start swarm on their own and burn quota

body.zh-TW: 沒輸入 `/swarm` 的情況下，以前代理有時會擅自啟動 swarm（多代理協作模式），消耗比單一代理多出許多的額度。這個問題已經修好，目前不會再將 swarm 技能提供給代理主動呼叫，而你手動輸入 `/swarm` 依然跟以前一樣能正常使用。
body.en: Even without typing `/swarm`, agents used to occasionally launch swarm (multi-agent collaboration mode) on their own and use far more quota than a single agent. This issue is fixed: the swarm skill is no longer offered to the agent to invoke proactively, while typing `/swarm` manually still works as before.

items.original: Fixed agents starting a swarm on their own when you hadn't typed `/swarm`, which can use far more of your quota than a single agent; the swarm skill is no longer offered to the agent, and `/swarm` works as before.

title.zh-TW: 非 QWERTY 鍵盤快捷鍵改依配置對應
title.en: Shortcuts on non-QWERTY keyboards now follow your layout

body.zh-TW: 習慣用非標準 QWERTY 鍵盤在 Ghostty 等終端機打字，以前按 `Ctrl` 或 `Alt` 快捷鍵常會誤觸別的鍵。這個問題已經修好，無論 Neo2、Dvorak、AZERTY 或德文 QWERTZ 配置，`Ctrl+C`、`Ctrl+D` 等組合鍵現在都會依實際鍵盤配置運作。
body.en: If you type on a non-QWERTY keyboard in terminals like Ghostty, pressing `Ctrl` or `Alt` shortcuts used to register as a different key. This issue is fixed: across Neo2, Dvorak, AZERTY, and German QWERTZ layouts, shortcuts like `Ctrl+C` and `Ctrl+D` now follow your active keyboard layout.

items.original: Fixed `Ctrl` and `Alt` shortcuts, such as `Ctrl+C` and `Ctrl+D`, acting as a different key on non-QWERTY keyboard layouts like Neo2, Dvorak, AZERTY, or German QWERTZ in terminals such as Ghostty; shortcuts now follow your keyboard layout.

title.zh-TW: Vim 模式在驚嘆號模式執行命令不再只換行
title.en: Enter in Vim `!` shell mode now runs commands instead of adding a newline

body.zh-TW: 開著 Vim 操作、打 `!` 進終端機下指令，過去打完按 `Enter` 卻只會往下多空一行，指令送不出去。這個問題已經修好，現在於相同模式下按 `Enter` 就會直接執行指令。
body.en: When Vim mode was on and you typed `!` to enter shell mode and run a command, pressing `Enter` used to just insert a blank line instead of submitting it. This issue is fixed: pressing `Enter` in that mode now runs the command directly.

items.original: Fixed `Enter` adding a new line instead of running the command in `!` shell mode when Vim mode is on.

title.zh-TW: Termux 執行 agy update 不再失敗
title.en: agy update no longer fails in Termux

body.zh-TW: 跑 `agy update` 更新工具，Android 的 Termux 環境過去總是失敗。畫面上會跳出 `directory /apex/com.android.runtime/bin is not fully accessible` 錯誤。這個問題已經修好，現在在 Termux 執行這項指令不會再出現這個錯誤。
body.en: Running `agy update` to update the tool used to fail in Android's Termux environment with a `directory /apex/com.android.runtime/bin is not fully accessible` error. This issue is fixed, and running the command in Termux no longer triggers that error.

items.original: Fixed `agy update` on Android (Termux) failing with a `directory /apex/com.android.runtime/bin is not fully accessible` error.

title.zh-TW: /config 的 Send Immediately 提示更正
title.en: Corrected Send Immediately hint in /config

body.zh-TW: 代理還在跑的時候想先插話傳訊息，以前看設定畫面的說明會以為送出就會直接打斷目前工作。這項說明現在已經更正，在 `/config` 的 `Queued Messages` 底下查看 `Send Immediately` 選項，會清楚寫明你的訊息會加入目前這輪對話，代理跑完眼前的這一步後就會讀到。
body.en: When you wanted to send a message while the agent was still running, the hint on the settings screen used to make it sound like sending would interrupt the current work right away. That hint is now corrected: under `Queued Messages` in `/config`, the `Send Immediately` option clearly states that your message joins the current turn and the agent reads it after finishing its current step.

items.original: Fixed the `/config` hint for the `Send Immediately` option of `Queued Messages`, which said it interrupts the agent; it now says your message joins the current turn and the agent reads it after its current step.

title.zh-TW: JSON 輸出重試成功後改回報 SUCCESS
title.en: JSON output now reports SUCCESS after a retried request succeeds

body.zh-TW: 用 `--output-format json` 或 `stream-json` 讀取結果，過去只要中途重試過模型請求，就算最後成功，`status` 仍會顯示 `ERROR` 並夾帶舊錯誤。這個問題已經修好，現在只要 CLI 重試後完成執行，結果的 `status` 就會正確寫成 `SUCCESS`。
body.en: When reading output with `--output-format json` or `stream-json`, any run that had retried a model request along the way used to still report `status` as `ERROR` along with the stale error, even if it ultimately succeeded. This issue is fixed: once the CLI completes a run after a retry, the result's `status` is now accurately reported as `SUCCESS`.

items.original: Fixed the `status` of `--output-format json` and `stream-json` results reading `ERROR`, with the error of a failed attempt, for runs that succeeded after the CLI retried a model request; they now report `SUCCESS`.

title.zh-TW: 外部編輯器連 agy acp 的操作與顯示修正
title.en: Operation and display fixes for external editors connected via agy acp

body.zh-TW:
透過 `agy acp` 把 Zed 或 JetBrains AI Chat 這類編輯器連上 Antigravity，現在檔案路徑、選單與訊息呈現都照實運作。

代理執行終端機指令的目錄以前會誤用編輯器啟動時的位置，例如家目錄；現在改回在該工作階段的專案資料夾執行。

在 Zed 等編輯器附上還沒存檔的內容給代理時，以前代理只看得到硬碟上舊的存檔；現在能直接讀取編輯器傳來的最新內容。

接上企業模型閘道時，編輯器模型選單過去會出現內部 `MODEL_PLACEHOLDER_...` 代號與重複名稱；現在每個模型只依代號列一次，同名模型旁也會標出代號。

模型請求重試時，編輯器聊天室以前每次都會跳出 `API error (attempt N)`，連後來成功也不例外。現在重試過程比照終端機保持安靜，只有全部重試都失敗時才顯示錯誤。
body.en:
When you connect editors like Zed or JetBrains AI Chat to Antigravity via `agy acp`, file paths, menus, and messages now work as expected.

Previously, the agent ran terminal commands in the directory the editor launched from, such as your home directory; it now runs them in the session's project folder instead.

When attaching unsaved content to the agent in editors like Zed, the agent previously only saw the older saved version on disk; it can now read the latest content sent by the editor directly.

When connected to an enterprise model gateway, the editor's model picker previously showed internal `MODEL_PLACEHOLDER_...` IDs and duplicate names; each model is now listed once by its ID, and models sharing a name show their ID next to it.

When a model request was retried, the editor's chat previously displayed `API error (attempt N)` every time, even if the retry later succeeded. Retries are now silent, just like in the terminal, and an error is shown only when all retries fail.

items.original:
Fixed `agy acp` running the agent's shell commands in the directory the editor launched it from, such as your home directory, instead of the session's project folder.
Fixed `agy acp` ignoring the file contents an editor attaches to a prompt, such as a file with unsaved changes in Zed; the agent now sees the editor's copy instead of the last saved version on disk.
Fixed model pickers in editors connected through `agy acp`, such as Zed and JetBrains AI Chat, showing internal `MODEL_PLACEHOLDER_...` IDs and several rows with the same name when you use an enterprise model gateway; each model is now listed once under its model ID, and models that share a name show their ID next to it.
Fixed `agy acp` showing an `API error (attempt N)` message in the editor's chat each time the CLI retried a model request, even when the retry succeeded; retries are now silent, as in the terminal, and the chat shows an error only when every retry fails.

title.zh-TW: /antigravity-guide 不再讀成轉址頁
title.en: /antigravity-guide no longer reads a redirect page

body.zh-TW: 問代理最新版本有什麼新東西，讓它透過內建 `/antigravity-guide` 技能查官方文件或更新紀錄時，過去只會讀到轉址通知，讀不到實際頁面。這個問題已經修好，現在能讀到頁面內容來回答問題。
body.en: When you asked the agent what's new in the latest release and it used the built-in `/antigravity-guide` skill to check the official docs or changelog, it previously read only a redirect notice instead of the actual page. This has been fixed, and it can now read the page content to answer your questions.

items.original: Fixed the built-in `/antigravity-guide` skill reading a redirect notice instead of the page when the agent looked up the Antigravity docs or changelog to answer your questions, such as what's new in the latest release.

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制網頁回答權限提示不再跳位或重置
title.en: Remote Control web view no longer jumps or resets when answering permission prompts

body.zh-TW:
在遠端控制網頁替代理批核請求，以前送出回答後畫面常會跑掉，網路微斷一下還得重填。

回答完權限提示後，過去對話畫面會隨著提示框關閉往下滑動，打亂原本的閱讀位置；現在對話會停在你正在看的段落。

若遇到短暫斷線，權限提示原本會整個重置，導致你挑好的選項、修改過的指令或路徑，以及在 `No` 欄位輸入的文字全部遺失；現在這些內容都會保留下來。
body.en:
When approving requests for the agent in the Remote Control web view, the view previously often jumped after you submitted an answer, and a brief network drop forced you to fill it out again.

After answering a permission prompt, the conversation view previously slid down as the prompt closed, disrupting your reading position; the conversation now stays on the section you are reading.

If a brief disconnection occurred, the permission prompt previously reset completely, losing the option you picked, your edits to the command or path, and any text typed into the `No` field; all of these are now preserved.

items.original:
Fixed the Remote Control browser view jumping when you answer a permission prompt; the conversation now stays where you were reading instead of sliding down as the prompt closes.
Fixed permission prompts in the Remote Control browser view resetting after a brief connection drop, which lost the option you had picked, your edits to the command or path, and anything you had typed for the `No` option.

title.zh-TW: 儀表板新增 /rename 幫工作階段改名
title.en: Dashboard adds /rename to rename sessions

body.zh-TW: 列表中同時留著好幾條舊紀錄，想替其中一條換個好認的標記，卻不想一一打開。現在選好目標後輸入 `/rename`，就能直接把那個工作階段改名，不用先打開它。⟦就像站在書架前替書換書腰，以前得先把整本書抽出來翻過才能改名，現在不用打開內頁就能直接寫上新名字。⟧
body.en: Several old records sit in the list, and you want to give one a clearer label without opening each one. Now you can select the target and enter `/rename` to rename that session directly without opening it first. ⟦Picture standing at a bookshelf to swap a book's belly band: before, you had to pull the whole book out and flip through it to change the name, whereas now you can write the new name right away without opening the pages.⟧

items.original: New `/rename` command on the dashboard renames the selected session without opening it

title.zh-TW: 新增 /models 指令從伺服器重抓模型清單
title.en: New /models command refreshes the model list from the server

body.zh-TW: 不確定畫面上顯示的模型還是不是最新一批，卻不想靠猜的。輸入 `/models`，就會直接向伺服器重新抓取目前可用的模型清單。⟦跟走到自動販賣機前按下更新鍵一樣，不用憑印象猜測，直接向倉庫抓回最新上架的品項清單。⟧
body.en: You are not sure whether the models shown on screen are still the latest batch, and you do not want to guess. Entering `/models` fetches the currently available model list directly from the server again. ⟦Think of walking up to a vending machine and pressing a refresh button: instead of guessing from memory, you pull the latest stocked item list straight from the warehouse.⟧

items.original: New `/models` command refreshes the available model list from the server

title.zh-TW: /hooks 清單改用清楚欄位顯示檔名與設定
title.en: /hooks list now shows file names and settings in clear fields

body.zh-TW: 查看自動化設定不用再對著原始指令硬猜用途。`/hooks` 清單每一列現在都會顯示 hook（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）的檔案名稱。各項設定也改成在易讀的欄位裡列出，不再直接傾倒原始指令。⟦配電箱打開來，以前裡面只塞著一長串難懂的原始線路代號，現在每個開關旁都印好檔名跟設定項目。⟧
body.en: Checking your automation setup no longer means guessing what raw commands do. Each row in the `/hooks` list now displays the file name of the hook (a small program triggered by a specific event). Settings are also listed in readable fields instead of dumping raw commands. ⟦Open a breaker box: before, it was stuffed with a long string of cryptic raw wiring codes, and now each switch has its file name and settings printed right beside it.⟧

items.original: `/hooks` rows now show the hook file name and list settings in readable fields instead of dumping raw commands

title.zh-TW: MCP 伺服器檢視與開關設定更準確
title.en: More accurate MCP server inspection and toggle behavior

body.zh-TW:
調整或檢查 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器時，現在能看到更清楚的狀態與路徑。

在 `/mcps` 裡，除非裡頭超過十台伺服器，否則代管區塊預設會直接展開。

在已經執行的終端機介面工作階段裡，`grok mcp disable` 與 `grok mcp enable` 現在能正確停止對應的伺服器。

執行 `grok inspect` 檢查專案自訂的 MCP 伺服器時，回報的設定檔位置現在能正確對應到 `.grok/config.toml` 或 `.mcp.json`。

這樣一來，清單展開範圍、進行中工作階段的伺服器停用，以及設定檔路徑都跟實際狀態一致。
body.en:
When adjusting or checking MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) servers, you now see clearer statuses and paths.

In `/mcps`, hosted sections are now expanded by default unless they contain more than ten servers.

Inside already-running terminal UI sessions, `grok mcp disable` and `grok mcp enable` now properly stop the corresponding servers.

When running `grok inspect` on project-defined MCP servers, the reported config file location now accurately points to `.grok/config.toml` or `.mcp.json`.

As a result, list expansion scope, stopping servers in active sessions, and config file paths all match the actual state.

items.original:
`/mcps` now shows hosted sections expanded by default unless they contain more than ten servers
`grok mcp disable` (and enable) now correctly stops servers inside already-running TUI sessions
`grok inspect` now reports the correct project `.grok/config.toml` or `.mcp.json` file for project-defined MCP servers

title.zh-TW: /workflows 清單按 Enter 可直接開檔並搜尋
title.en: Pressing Enter in /workflows opens the file for viewing and searching

body.zh-TW: 平時對照工作流程定義，總得確認裡面的步驟寫法。現在游標停在 `/workflows` 清單的項目上按下 `Enter`，就會直接開啟該流程的檔案，方便你瀏覽與搜尋內容。
body.en: When reviewing workflow definitions, you often need to check how the steps are written. Now, pressing `Enter` on an item in the `/workflows` list opens that workflow's file directly so you can browse and search its contents.

items.original: Enter on a workflow in the `/workflows` list now opens its file for viewing and searching

title.zh-TW: 全展開模式重複收合思考時會提示關閉快捷鍵
title.en: Hint shows the toggle shortcut when repeatedly collapsing thoughts in expand-all mode

body.zh-TW: 每次回答一長串思考過程，你可能忍不住一塊一塊手動把它們摺起來，卻忘了全部展開模式還開著。在全部展開開啟的狀態下，只要你持續把思考段落一個個收起來，畫面就會跳出提示，列出用來關掉全部展開的組合鍵。⟦你一盞一盞手動關掉小燈，旁邊的人看你連按好幾顆，就會順手指給你看總開關的位置在哪。⟧
body.en: When a response includes a long chain of thought steps, you might find yourself folding them up one by one without realizing expand-all mode is still on. While expand-all is enabled, if you keep collapsing thought sections individually, a hint appears showing the key chord that turns expand-all off. ⟦As you switch off small lights one by one, someone watching you press several switches in a row points out where the master switch is.⟧

items.original: A new contextual hint appears when you keep collapsing thoughts while expand-all is on, showing the chord that turns it off

title.zh-TW: 問答卡打字與貼上回答不再誤觸快捷鍵或捲過頭
title.en: Typing and pasting on question cards no longer trigger shortcuts or overscroll

body.zh-TW:
在問答卡上想填寫自己的回答，以前操作常出狀況。現在打字或貼上回答內容，都不會再被誤認成快捷鍵。

打字輸入回答的過程中，問答卡清單也不會再捲超過最後一個選項。
body.en:
Entering your own answer on a question card used to run into input issues. Now, typing or pasting an answer is no longer misinterpreted as a shortcut.

While typing an answer, the question card list also no longer scrolls past the last option.

items.original:
Typed or pasted answers on question cards are no longer misinterpreted as shortcuts
Question card lists no longer scroll past the last option while typing an answer

title.zh-TW: 儀表板派送與快速檢視回覆框操作改進
title.en: Improved controls in dashboard dispatch and peek reply boxes

body.zh-TW:
打字打一半想一口氣清掉剛敲錯的字詞，不用再連按倒退鍵。現在在儀表板的派送與快速檢視回覆框裡按 `Ctrl+W`，就能刪掉前一個單字。

當派送訊息正在等待圖片傳送時，快速檢視回覆框依然可以正常接收按鍵輸入與貼上內容。
body.en:
When you want to clear a mistyped word mid-sentence, you no longer need to tap backspace repeatedly. Pressing `Ctrl+W` in the dashboard dispatch and peek reply boxes now deletes the previous word.

While a dispatch message is waiting on an image transfer, the peek reply box still accepts keystrokes and pasted content normally.

items.original:
Ctrl+W now deletes the previous word in the dashboard dispatch and peek reply boxes
Dashboard peek still accepts keys and pastes while a dispatch send waits on an image

title.zh-TW: 接續工作階段後背景任務與工作流程位置修正
title.en: Fixed placement of background tasks and workflows after resuming a session

body.zh-TW: 事情做到一半暫停，回頭重開紀錄繼續進行，裡頭有些項目常會插錯順序。這個問題已經修好，現在重開工作階段後，背景任務與工作流程都會出現在對話紀錄裡正確的順序位置。
body.en: When you paused halfway through a task and reopened the record to continue, some items would end up out of order. That issue is fixed: after resuming a session, background tasks and workflows now appear in the right order in the transcript.

items.original: Background tasks and workflows now appear in the correct place in the transcript after resuming a session

title.zh-TW: 搜尋與篩選列的選取錯位與語法錯誤提示修正
title.en: Fixed selection offset and syntax error message in search and filter bars

body.zh-TW:
在區塊檢視器裡用搜尋列找內容，以前容易點選到被搜尋列蓋住的那一行。現在搜尋列不會再誤選被它擋在底下的那行文字。

當輸入的 regex（正規表達式，用符號匹配字串的語法）格式無效時，搜尋列與篩選列現在會直接顯示 `bad pattern`。
body.en:
When searching in the block viewer, it used to be easy to select the line covered by the search bar. The search bar no longer mistakenly selects the line of text hidden underneath it.

When an invalid regex (regular expression, a syntax for matching strings with symbols) is entered, the search and filter bars now directly display `bad pattern`.

items.original:
Block viewer search bar no longer selects the line hidden under it
Search and filter bars now show `bad pattern` when the regex is invalid

title.zh-TW: 回覆中的無效連結改顯示為純文字
title.en: Dead links in replies now appear as plain text

body.zh-TW: 回覆裡有時會夾帶已經失效的連結，過去畫面還是把它畫成可點擊的超連結。現在回覆中的無效連結只會以純文字呈現，不會再顯示為可點擊的連結。
body.en: Replies sometimes include dead links, which the screen used to render as clickable hyperlinks. Now dead links in replies appear only as plain text rather than clickable links.

items.original: Dead links in replies now appear as plain text rather than clickable links

title.zh-TW: /goal pause 後的階段計時器改從零起算
title.en: Phase timers after /goal pause now start from zero

body.zh-TW: 使用 `/goal pause` 之後查看階段計時，過去畫面上會留著過時的舊時間。現在 `/goal pause` 後的階段計時器會從零開始計時，不再顯示殘留的舊時間。
body.en: When checking phase timing after using `/goal pause`, the screen used to keep showing stale time. Now phase timers after `/goal pause` start from zero and no longer display leftover old time.

items.original: Phase timers after `/goal pause` now start from zero instead of showing stale time

title.zh-TW: grok update 輸出不再夾帶內部代號與設定檔
title.en: grok update output no longer includes internal IDs or config files

body.zh-TW: 更新完工具想確認畫面訊息，以前總會混進幾行給研發端看的編號和檔名。現在 `grok update` 的輸出已經移除這些內部項目，不再顯示實驗 ID 或設定檔名稱。
body.en: When checking screen messages after updating the tool, a few lines of IDs and filenames meant for developers used to get mixed in. Now `grok update` has removed these internal items from its output and no longer displays experiment IDs or config file names.

items.original: `grok update` no longer mentions internal experiment IDs or config files in its output

title.zh-TW: 登入畫面貼上金鑰時不再點名環境變數
title.en: Sign-in screen no longer names an environment variable when pasting a key

body.zh-TW: 把存好的通行憑證複製進帳號驗證框，以前頁面還會順帶寫出一個系統參數的名字。現在當你可能貼上了已儲存的金鑰，登入畫面不再顯示環境變數名稱。
body.en: When copying a saved credential into the account verification box, the page used to also mention the name of a system parameter. Now when you may have pasted a saved key, the sign-in screen no longer displays an environment variable name.

items.original: Sign-in screen no longer names an environment variable when a saved key may have been pasted

title.zh-TW: 服務端連上卻不回傳時對話與壓縮不再卡死
title.en: Turns and compaction no longer hang when a provider connects without responding

body.zh-TW: 進行對話輪次或壓縮對話內容，萬一供應商雖然建立連線卻始終沒送回回應，以前畫面會就此卡住。這個問題已經修好，現在碰到供應商連上卻無回應時，輪次與對話壓縮都不會再卡死。
body.en: During conversation turns or content compaction, if a provider established a connection but never sent back a response, the screen used to freeze. This issue is now fixed, so when a provider connects without responding, neither turns nor conversation compaction will hang anymore.

items.original: Turns and compaction no longer hang when a provider connects but never sends a response

title.zh-TW: 不支援看圖的模型讀到圖片不再中斷

body.zh-TW:
手邊用的是不能辨識圖片的模型，以前碰到圖片會讓整個工作階段直接中斷。現在不論讀取圖片檔，或從 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）工具取得圖片，工作階段都不會再中斷，結果裡只會註明圖片沒有附上。

⟦跟只收純文字的舊款呼叫器一樣，以前收到照片會整台當機，現在只會顯示圖片沒附上，連線不會中斷。⟧
body.en:
If you are using a model that cannot recognize images, encountering an image used to break the entire session. Now, whether you read an image file or get an image from an MCP (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) tool, the session no longer breaks, and the result simply notes that the image was not attached.

⟦Like an old text-only pager that used to crash completely when receiving a photo, it now just shows that the image was not attached without dropping the connection.⟧

items.original: Reading an image file or getting an image from an MCP tool no longer breaks the session on a model that cannot view images; the result says the image was not attached

title.zh-TW: 編輯器內的代理工作階段無法存檔會跳警告

body.en: If you were in the middle of interacting with AI and the session could no longer be saved, you used to receive no notice. Now, whenever the session can no longer be saved, the editor shows a warning.

items.original: Agent sessions in editors warn when the session can no longer be saved

title.zh-TW: muse exec 的 JSON 附圖也會加編號
title.en: muse exec with JSON also numbers attached images

body.zh-TW: 過去執行 `muse exec --json --image` 帶入圖片，提示詞裡不會幫圖片加上編號。現在它會比照不加 `--json` 的 `muse exec --image`，在提示裡為每張附圖標上 `[Image #N]`。
body.en: Previously, running `muse exec --json --image` to include images did not number them in the prompt. Now, matching `muse exec --image` without `--json`, it labels each attached image `[Image #N]` in the prompt.

items.original: `muse exec --json --image` now labels each attached image `[Image #N]` in the prompt, as `muse exec --image` without `--json` already does

title.zh-TW: 短句開頭的非英文回答不再被丟棄重寫
title.en: Non-English answers after a short opening message are no longer discarded and rewritten

body.zh-TW:
第一則訊息只打幾個字，原本會讓法文、西班牙文、德文等外語回覆整個作廢重來。現在這些非英文回答都會留住。Muse 只會在你的訊息使用常見英文單字，或你主動要求用英文時，才會把工作階段語言設成英文。

⟦好比手機自動切換輸入法，以前開頭打太短就會把剛寫好的外語整段刪掉換成英文，現在除非出現常見英文詞或你主動要求，否則不會擅自換語言。⟧
body.en:
Typing just a few words in your first message used to cause replies in French, Spanish, German, and other non-English languages to be discarded and rewritten. Now those non-English answers are kept. Muse only sets the session language to English when your messages use common English words or when you ask for English.

⟦Picture a phone that auto-switches keyboards: previously, a short opening message would wipe out the foreign-language text you just wrote and replace it with English, whereas now it will not switch languages on its own unless common English words appear or you ask for it.⟧

items.original: Answers in French, Spanish, German, and other non-English languages are no longer discarded and rewritten when your first message is short; Muse sets English as the session language only when your messages use common English words or you ask for English

title.zh-TW: 壓縮完的工作階段不再回頭重讀全部紀錄
title.en: Compacted sessions no longer re-read their entire log

body.zh-TW: 工作階段剛做完壓縮，以前還會在背景把整份工作階段紀錄從頭再讀過。現在壓縮結束後，這項背景重讀已經取消。
body.en: Right after a session compacted, it used to re-read the entire session log from the beginning in the background. Now, once compaction finishes, that background re-read has been canceled.

items.original: A session that has compacted no longer re-reads its whole session log in the background after a compaction

first_title.zh-TW: Agent 遇阻回報與建置除錯流程改進
first_title.en: Improved Agent Blocker Reporting and Build Debugging

entries: **New panel theme: Maple Dusk.** Maple leaves drift down over a gold-to-violet sunset, behind and in front of violet glass cards that let the sky show through, with small piles of fallen leaves in the bottom corners. Pick it from **⚙ Settings → Switch Panel**; there are now 17 themes. The leaves stop moving when macOS Reduce Motion is on.

**The Muse quota card disappears once the subscription ends.** Before this fix, usage kept showing the last saved Muse quota after a subscription lapsed. Once its reset times passed, the card, the Claude Code quota line and the notifications treated that quota as unused. usage rechecked only after a new Muse conversation, so it never noticed. It now reruns the model-free `muse usage --json` at most every 5 minutes, which also brings the card up to date within about 5 minutes of using Muse instead of 30. When Muse reports that the account has no subscription allowance, usage deletes the saved quota without falling back to a `muse exec` model call, and the card disappears. It comes back once Muse reports quota again.

**A Codex window past its reset time reads 0% and Reset.** Before this fix, both its usage and its reset time showed `--`, which looked like missing data. It now matches Claude Code and Antigravity until Codex reports a new reading.

**An Antigravity day that was counted too high can now be lowered in the year ledger.** Before this fix, when a fresh recount matched the daily snapshot, usage kept the snapshot's missing record of which counting version produced each day. A day saved before the token-counting fix therefore stayed too high after upgrading. Only days replayed from the snapshot now keep the stored versions.

**The year report no longer shows two totals for the same day.** The report read or built its cached year before saving the new snapshot, so the detail showed the corrected total while the heatmap showed the old one, and that old year stayed cached for 6 hours. The snapshot is now saved first, and a verified recount of an outdated ledger day skips the cache.

**The year report includes this run's activity even when the ledger is busy.** If another process held the ledger lock for too long, the report fell back to the ledger on disk without the days counted in this run, then cached that incomplete result. usage now adds those days in memory and does not cache the incomplete report.
**usage no longer stops with an error when it cannot create the ledger's lock folder.** It now handles this the same way as a lock file it cannot open.

**A Muse 5-hour limit shows up as a current reading.** When Muse refused a request because the 5-hour quota was used up, usage kept the previous reading's check time. The card looked stale, the "used up" notification was skipped, and usage checked again sooner than intended. The refusal now carries its own check time.

**A newer Codex Spark reading no longer replaces the general Codex reading.** When the Codex database held a newer reading for the dedicated Spark quota, it replaced the general reading from the session logs, and a general-quota rejection looked expired. Readings for different quotas are no longer merged.

**Repairing Token Saver no longer replaces a newer hook with an older one.** When a prompt file or settings entry was missing, usage overwrote the installed Token Saver hooks with the copies bundled in the app, even if the installed ones were newer. usage now replaces a script only when it is missing or older, and restores just the missing parts, the same way it repairs the resume hook.

**Quota-aware mode says when Claude Code's own quota was last read.** The "Claude Code's own quota" line left out the "(last updated ...; it may have reset since)" note that the same windows carry elsewhere, so an old reading could look current. The quota-aware hook updates to 1.20.

**CSV exports show "—" for a project whose cost is unknown.** They used to write 0.00, which read as free. Both the app's export and the export inside a saved report now write "—", the same as model rows.

**An exported report reopens with the same date shortcut.** A report exported from a shortcut such as All reopened as a manual date range, without the shortcut and its history note. A report exported with hidden project names reopened with empty date fields. The export now stores the shortcut and restores it.
**Reports show Gemini 4 Neon by its short name.** The model table listed Antigravity's new Gemini 4 Neon models by their full IDs; they now read "Neon 4", like the other models.

title.zh-TW: 面板新增「楓紅暮色」主題
title.en: New "Maple Dusk" panel theme

body.zh-TW:
想替每天點開的畫面換上夕陽配色，現在共有 17 款造型可挑。進到「⚙ 設定 → 更換面板」就能選到「楓紅暮色」。

這款造型在金色到紫色的夕陽裡飄著楓葉，有的落在卡片後面、有的從前面飄過。卡片本身是能透出天空的半透明紫色玻璃，底部兩角還堆著落葉。macOS 開啟「減少動態效果」後，楓葉會停住不動。
body.en:
If you want a sunset palette for the panel you open every day, there are now 17 themes to choose from. Go to "⚙ Settings → Switch Panel" to select "Maple Dusk".

This theme features maple leaves drifting across a gold-to-violet sunset, with some falling behind the cards and others floating in front. The cards themselves are translucent violet glass that lets the sky show through, with fallen leaves piled in both bottom corners. When macOS "Reduce Motion" is turned on, the leaves stop moving.

Pick it from **⚙ Settings → Switch Panel**; there are now 17 themes. The leaves stop moving when macOS Reduce Motion is on.

title.zh-TW: Muse 退訂後會移除額度卡並加快重查
title.en: Muse removes the quota card after unsubscribing and rechecks faster

body.zh-TW:
從前帳號沒有續約，只要沒開新的 Muse 對話，usage 就不會主動重查，一直留著最後存下的舊讀數。一旦過了重置時間，額度卡、Claude Code 的額度提示和通知都會把這份舊資料當成還沒用過。

現在 usage 最多每 5 分鐘重跑一次不呼叫模型的 `muse usage --json`，平常用過 Muse 後約 5 分鐘內就會更新，不必等 30 分鐘。只要 Muse 回報帳號沒有訂閱額度，usage 就會刪掉舊紀錄、不改用 `muse exec` 呼叫模型，額度卡也隨之消失；等之後再查到額度，卡片就會重新出現。⟦從前停訂雜誌後，沒再開新刊就沒人去翻信箱，牆上還掛著上期的剩餘期數；現在會定時探頭看訂戶狀態而不拆封試讀，確認退訂就把牌子收起，續訂再掛回去。⟧
body.en:
Previously, if an account did not renew, usage would not actively recheck as long as no new Muse conversation was opened, keeping the last saved old reading. Once the reset time passed, the quota card, Claude Code's quota prompt, and notifications all treated that old data as unused.

Now usage reruns the model-free `muse usage --json` at most every 5 minutes, so after regular Muse use it updates within about 5 minutes instead of waiting 30 minutes. Whenever Muse reports that the account has no subscription quota, usage deletes the old record without falling back to calling a model with `muse exec`, and the quota card disappears; once quota is found again later, the card reappears. ⟦Previously, after canceling a magazine subscription, nobody checked the mailbox unless a new issue was opened, leaving the remaining issue count from the last issue hanging on the wall; now someone peeks at the subscriber status on a schedule without unsealing a sample copy, takes down the sign once cancellation is confirmed, and hangs it back up upon renewal.⟧

items.original: **The Muse quota card disappears once the subscription ends.** Before this fix, usage kept showing the last saved Muse quota after a subscription lapsed. Once its reset times passed, the card, the Claude Code quota line and the notifications treated that quota as unused. usage rechecked only after a new Muse conversation, so it never noticed. It now reruns the model-free `muse usage --json` at most every 5 minutes, which also brings the card up to date within about 5 minutes of using Muse instead of 30. When Muse reports that the account has no subscription allowance, usage deletes the saved quota without falling back to a `muse exec` model call, and the card disappears. It comes back once Muse reports quota again.

title.zh-TW: 各工具額度讀數與重置狀態更準確
title.en: More accurate quota readings and reset states across tools

body.zh-TW:
面板出現舊數字或 `--`，常讓人分不清額度是已重置還是沒讀到。

Codex 過了重置時間，現在比照 Claude Code 和 Antigravity 顯示 0% 與「已重置」，直到下次報出新讀數。以前這兩欄只顯示 `--`，像讀不到資料。

Muse 因 5 小時額度用完而拒絕時，現在帶有自己的檢查時間。過去沿用上一筆時間，讓卡片像過期、漏發「已用完」通知，也過早重查。

較新的 Codex Spark 讀數不再蓋掉工作階段紀錄裡的一般讀數。不同額度不再合併，一般額度的拒絕不會再顯得過期。

額度感知模式在「Claude Code 自己的額度」補上「（最後更新於…；之後可能已重置）」，舊讀數不會再像最新的。額度感知 hook（特定事件發生時觸發的小程式）更新到 1.20。

各類額度的時間與狀態分清後，看面板剩餘量不用再靠猜。
body.en:
When old numbers or `--` appear in the panel, it is often hard to tell whether a quota has reset or could not be read.

Once Codex passes its reset time, it now matches Claude Code and Antigravity by showing 0% and "Reset" until a new reading is reported. Previously, both fields only showed `--`, looking like unreadable data.

When Muse refuses a request because the 5-hour quota is used up, it now carries its own check time. Previously, it reused the previous entry's time, making the card look stale, skipping the "used up" notification, and rechecking too early.

Newer Codex Spark readings no longer overwrite general readings in session logs. Different quotas are no longer merged, so a general-quota refusal no longer looks expired.

Quota-aware mode adds "(last updated ...; it may have reset since)" to "Claude Code's own quota", so old readings no longer look current. The quota-aware hook (a small program triggered by specific events) is updated to 1.20.

With the timing and status of each quota separated clearly, checking remaining amounts in the panel no longer requires guessing.

items.original:
**A Codex window past its reset time reads 0% and Reset.** Before this fix, both its usage and its reset time showed `--`, which looked like missing data. It now matches Claude Code and Antigravity until Codex reports a new reading.
**A Muse 5-hour limit shows up as a current reading.** When Muse refused a request because the 5-hour quota was used up, usage kept the previous reading's check time. The card looked stale, the "used up" notification was skipped, and usage checked again sooner than intended. The refusal now carries its own check time.
**A newer Codex Spark reading no longer replaces the general Codex reading.** When the Codex database held a newer reading for the dedicated Spark quota, it replaced the general reading from the session logs, and a general-quota rejection looked expired. Readings for different quotas are no longer merged.
**Quota-aware mode says when Claude Code's own quota was last read.** The "Claude Code's own quota" line left out the "(last updated ...; it may have reset since)" note that the same windows carry elsewhere, so an old reading could look current. The quota-aware hook updates to 1.20.

title.zh-TW: 年度帳本與報表數字不再對不攏
title.en: Year ledger and report numbers no longer mismatch

body.zh-TW:
升級後回頭對年度明細與熱力圖，現在不用擔心舊紀錄把數字拖偏。

以前重算若跟每日快照相同，會沿用快照缺少版本的紀錄。這讓 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）修正前多算的 Antigravity 日子調不下來，現在只剩從快照重播的日子才沿用存下的版本。

年度報表以前先讀或建快取（把算過的結果暫存起來直接用）才存快照，讓明細跟熱力圖不同步、舊資料留存 6 小時。現在會先存快照，確認過舊帳本重算也略過快取。

帳本鎖被別的程序占住太久時，報表以前改讀磁碟帳本卻漏算這次用量還存進快取。現在會在記憶體補進這些日子，也不快取不完整報表。

建不出帳本鎖資料夾時，usage 不再報錯中斷，改比照打不開鎖檔處理。

明細、熱力圖與當次用量都能真正對齊。
body.en:
When checking annual details and heatmaps after upgrading, you no longer have to worry about old records skewing the numbers.

Previously, if a recount matched the daily snapshot, it kept the snapshot's version-less record. That prevented Antigravity days overcounted before the token (the text unit AI processes and bills for) fix from being lowered, whereas now only days replayed from the snapshot keep the stored versions.

Previously, the year report read or built its cache before saving the snapshot, causing the details and heatmap to go out of sync and keeping old data for 6 hours. Now it saves the snapshot first, and verified recounts of outdated ledger days also skip the cache.

When another process held the ledger lock for too long, the report previously fell back to reading the ledger on disk, omitted this run's usage, and still saved that to the cache. Now it adds those days in memory and does not cache incomplete reports.

When usage cannot create the ledger lock folder, it no longer stops with an error and instead handles it the same way as a lock file it cannot open.

Details, heatmaps, and current-run usage now truly align.

items.original:
**An Antigravity day that was counted too high can now be lowered in the year ledger.** Before this fix, when a fresh recount matched the daily snapshot, usage kept the snapshot's missing record of which counting version produced each day. A day saved before the token-counting fix therefore stayed too high after upgrading. Only days replayed from the snapshot now keep the stored versions.
**The year report no longer shows two totals for the same day.** The report read or built its cached year before saving the new snapshot, so the detail showed the corrected total while the heatmap showed the old one, and that old year stayed cached for 6 hours. The snapshot is now saved first, and a verified recount of an outdated ledger day skips the cache.
**The year report includes this run's activity even when the ledger is busy.** If another process held the ledger lock for too long, the report fell back to the ledger on disk without the days counted in this run, then cached that incomplete result. usage now adds those days in memory and does not cache the incomplete report.
**usage no longer stops with an error when it cannot create the ledger's lock folder.** It now handles this the same way as a lock file it cannot open.

title.zh-TW: 修復精簡模式不再用舊 hook 蓋掉新版
title.en: Repairing Token Saver no longer overwrites newer hooks with older ones

body.zh-TW: 之前提示檔或設定項目不見了，usage 修補精簡模式會直接拿 app 內附的腳本硬蓋過去，害你自己裝好的新版 hook 反而被退回舊版。現在只有腳本不見或版本較舊時才會替換，其餘只補回缺漏的部分，做法跟修復續談 hook 一樣。
body.en: Previously, when a prompt file or settings entry was missing, repairing Token Saver in usage overwrote things directly with the scripts bundled in the app, downgrading newer hooks you had installed yourself. Now a script is replaced only when it is missing or older, while everything else only has the missing parts restored, the same way the resume hook is repaired.

items.original: **Repairing Token Saver no longer replaces a newer hook with an older one.** When a prompt file or settings entry was missing, usage overwrote the installed Token Saver hooks with the copies bundled in the app, even if the installed ones were newer. usage now replaces a script only when it is missing or older, and restores just the missing parts, the same way it repairs the resume hook.

title.zh-TW: 匯出與重開報表的表格標示更清楚
title.en: Clearer table labels when exporting and reopening reports

body.zh-TW:
整理報表匯出存檔，或是重新打開舊報表核對花費，表格上的資訊現在不會漏掉或寫錯。

遇到花費未知的專案，CSV 匯出會寫成破折號，跟模型列一樣。以前會寫成 0.00 讓人誤以為免費，現在 app 直接匯出或存下報表裡的匯出都改過來了。

用「全部」這類日期捷徑匯出的報表，重新打開會直接還原原本的捷徑和歷史說明，不再變成手動選日期範圍。隱藏專案名稱匯出的報表，重開時日期欄也不會再是空的。

模型表裡 Antigravity 的新 Gemini 4 Neon 模型，以前會列出完整 ID，現在跟其他模型一樣改用簡稱「Neon 4」。

以後把報表匯出來對帳或傳給別人看，花費、日期條件跟模型名稱都不會再走樣。
body.en:
Whether exporting reports to save or reopening old reports to check spending, table information will no longer be missing or wrong.

For projects with unknown cost, CSV exports now write "—", the same as model rows. Previously they wrote 0.00, making them look free; both direct app exports and exports inside saved reports now fix this.

Reports exported with a date shortcut like "All" now reopen with the original shortcut and its history note restored instead of turning into a manual date range. Reports exported with hidden project names also no longer have empty date fields when reopened.

In the model table, Antigravity's new Gemini 4 Neon models previously listed their full IDs and now use the short name "Neon 4", like the other models.

From now on, when you export reports to reconcile expenses or share with others, costs, date criteria, and model names will no longer be distorted.

items.original:
**CSV exports show "—" for a project whose cost is unknown.** They used to write 0.00, which read as free. Both the app's export and the export inside a saved report now write "—", the same as model rows.
**An exported report reopens with the same date shortcut.** A report exported from a shortcut such as All reopened as a manual date range, without the shortcut and its history note. A report exported with hidden project names reopened with empty date fields. The export now stores the shortcut and restores it.
**Reports show Gemini 4 Neon by its short name.** The model table listed Antigravity's new Gemini 4 Neon models by their full IDs; they now read "Neon 4", like the other models.

## Protect private forks when deleting repositories

`gh repo delete` now warns when deleting a private or internal repository will also delete its forks. The additional confirmation is required even with `--yes`.

Non-interactive workflows and agents must explicitly accept the cascading deletion:

```shell
gh repo delete OWNER/REPO --yes --accept-cascading-deletion-of-private-forks
```

title.zh-TW: 刪除私有或內部儲存庫前會再確認 fork
title.en: Confirming forks again before deleting private or internal repositories

body.zh-TW:
清理不再維護的 GitHub 儲存庫，不少人習慣在 `gh repo delete` 後面補上 `--yes` 直接跳過確認。現在要刪的如果是私有或內部儲存庫，而且會一併刪掉底下的 fork（從原儲存庫另外複製出去的獨立副本），指令就會先跳出警告。這時你得再確認一次，就算已經加上 `--yes` 也一樣。

如果是沒有人手輸入的非互動式流程或代理程式，執行刪除就必須明確加上同意連帶刪除的參數：

```shell
gh repo delete OWNER/REPO --yes --accept-cascading-deletion-of-private-forks
```

⟦就像管理員要關掉大樓的總電源，以前只要拿到授權單就直接斷電，現在發現線路還接著其他人的設備，就會先暫停並要求再確認，連自動排程也得另外寫明同意一併斷電。⟧
body.en:
When cleaning up unmaintained GitHub repositories, many people add `--yes` after `gh repo delete` to skip confirmation. Now, if the repository you are deleting is private or internal and will also delete its forks (independent copies made from the original repository), the command warns you first. You then have to confirm a second time, even if you already passed `--yes`.

For non-interactive workflows or agents without manual input, running the deletion requires explicitly adding the flag that accepts cascading deletion:

```shell
gh repo delete OWNER/REPO --yes --accept-cascading-deletion-of-private-forks
```

⟦Picture a building manager shutting off the main power: previously, an authorization slip was enough to cut it right away, but now if the lines still feed other people's equipment, the process pauses for a second confirmation—and even automated schedules must separately state they agree to cut power to those as well.⟧
